scripts.check: biome check . && bun run --cwd web check:i18n && bun run check:kit
scripts.//check:local: Checks that CANNOT run on GitHub, so localci runs them on the host instead. check:kit compares this app's kit-managed copies against lunarwerx-ui, a PRIVATE sibling repo a public repo's CI can never check out. Without this its only enforcement is the pre-commit hook, which --no-verify skips and which silently no-ops on any machine without the sibling checkout.
scripts.//check:deep: The everything lane, run before a release and by nobody in a hurry: check, every package typecheck, then test:full (25+ minutes of Python unittest included). It exists so the orchestrator suites are reachable from a gate lane by name, which is how the Architect decides a test script verifies anything.
scripts.check:deep: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:full
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd web typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd orchestrator/web typecheck && bun run --cwd orchestrator/server typecheck
scripts.//test: `test` is the everyday lane (seconds): the bun suites at the root and orchestrator/server's (the remote gateway). `test:full` adds the Python toolbox's own unittest discover (test:orchestrator), which takes 25+ minutes on this box; CI runs that same discover step in its own job (.github/workflows/ci.yml), so nothing verifies nothing. Wired 2026-09-15 for the Architect's verification-coverage-reachability check, which reads package.json lanes and not workflows.
scripts.test: bun test --parallel=4 && bun run --cwd orchestrator/server test
scripts.test:full: bun run test && bun run test:orchestrator
scripts.//save:bundle: ONLY when the owner has said to sweep the whole dirty tree. Commits everything as one `wip: bundle` commit whose message names every file taken from another session (Mine:/Swept:), so the peer finds out from the log. Never --no-verify; the commit-msg hook checks the list.
